Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from the first game. India have emerged victorious and they have done it quite easily in the end. They face Pakistan next on the 11th of November at 1100 local (1500 GMT) at this same venue. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Indian skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur, who is giving her second interview, says winning and losing are a part of the game. Mentions that the new coach Ramesh Powar has changed their mindset and they are happy he is a part of their team. States that Mithali Raj is one of their key players and it is their plan of sending her down the order. Adds further that Rodrigues does not feel the pressure and she is an exciting player. Ends by saying that there is room for improvement in the bowling department.

New Zealand skipper, Amy Satterthwaite, says they were outplayed today. Credits the way Kaur played. Admits that they weren't confident about using the DRS and hence did not use it. Adds that they tried everything against Kaur but nothing worked. Ends by saying that she is proud of the way her team played and she is now looking forward to the next game.

Man of the Match, Harmanpreet Kaur, says she feels good but there is still a long way to go. Mentions that there is still room for improvement. States that she knew she would catch up once she gets her eye in. Credits the way Rodrigues played and adds further that she is very mature but she can get much better. Ends by saying that she (Kaur) had a bit of a fever but she feels better now.

The task was always a big one for New Zealand. A target of 195 is never easy to chase. They got off to a good start via Bates and Peterson, but wickets kept falling. Bates held one end and scored a fifty, but it became too difficult after a point as she departed looking for the big hits. Martin provided a late impetus, but it was too late by then. The Indian bowlers piled on the pressure well and were backed up in the field as well. Barring Sharma, all got wickets, with Poonam and Hemalatha getting 3 apiece.

A commanding performance from India as they beat the Kiwis in some style. A large part of their win is down to skipper Harmanpreet Kaur's stunning maiden T20I ton. Her partnership of 134 runs with Rodrigues, which came after the top order rather fell cheaply, took the game completely away from New Zealand. The skipper really accelerated and made up for the poor start in the Powerplay. It was enough to get India to 194, which was the highest total in WWT20 history.

OUT! INDIA WIN BY 34 RUNS! A superb performance from the Women in Blue. Radha bowls it outside off, Jensen looks to swing this out of the park by coming down the track and misses. It's a mere formality for Bhatia behind the stumps.
Amelia Kerr next in.

OUT! Another wicket down! Kasperek skips down the track and lofts it short of a length ball towards long on. Not enough elevation on it, Sharma out in the deep comes running in to her left and takes a superb diving catch.
Full outside off, driven to the cover area.
FOUR! Two in two! Bit of a top edge but it's enough. Once again Kasperek is down on the ground as she brings out the slog sweep. It goes over short fine leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Fuller in line of the stumps, Kasperek moves a long way across her stumps, gets low and slog sweeps it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Drives this full ball towards mid on for a single.
Radha Yadav to bowl the final over.
FOUR! Short, width on offer outside off, Kasperek backs away and cuts it fiercely through point for a boundary.
Hayley Jensen is next in to bat.

OUT! A stunning knock from Martin comes to an end. A touch quicker and shorter around off, Martin swings and gets a top edge which skies towards extra cover. Kaur is there and she takes the catch without any problem whatsoever.
FOUR! Superb batting from Katey Martin. She skips down the track, gets close to the pitch and slams it over the covers for a boundary.
Straighter one outside off, it takes the edge of the bat and runs down to third man for one.
FOUR! Loopy and full from Poonam, Kasperek kneels down and nails the slog sweep to perfection. Through backward square leg and that's a boundary.
Dropped! Should have been taken. Martin dances down and whacks this straight back to Poonam. The bowler sticks her hands above but can't hold on to it. It falls behind her and a single is stolen.
Poonam Yadav to bowl the penultimate over.
It's been lofted down towards long on. One run taken.
High full toss outside off, it goes off the edge and runs down to third man for one.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
FOUR! Short of a good length well outside off, Martin goes across and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.

Not out! Martin survives. Full in length and just outside off, Martin makes room, gives the charge and looks to go big downtown. The ball goes past the bat and when Bhatia collects she appeals along with the bowler. Nothing from the umpire. The review is taken and it shows the noise was of the bat hitting the ground. Review lost.
The DRS is called for by India. It's for a caught behind decision against Katey Martin.
Well outside off, Martin swings but misses.
Wide! Way outside off, wide called by the umpire.
Arundhati Reddy is back.
Worked away comfortably on the leg side for a run. 10 from the over. 66 needed to win in 18.
Width offered outside off, cut away hard but straight to point.
FOUR! Excellent placement. Martin is down on one knee and sweeps it past short fine leg to find the fence.
Short and wide outside off, cut straight to cover.
FOUR! Martin keeps going on the charge. Moves a long way across, gets low and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary.
Swept away in front of square leg for one run.
Deepti Sharma to bowl now.
Well, well outside off, Martin moves across, gets low to bring out the big slog sweep but the ball goes under her bat.
Short and flat outside off, cut away square towards point.
FOUR! Floats it up around off, Martin brings out the broom and sweeps it nicely in the gap through square leg for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! That's a clever hit. Knows where the fielders are and takes advantage. Moves a long way across, waits for the slower ball to come and Martin slogs it through backward square leg for a boundary.
The batter failed to make contact and was hit low on the pads.
Outside off, quite slow in pace, Martin looks to hit it but fails.
Poonam Yadav is called back on.
Short ball, pulled away into the leg side for a single. 84 needed off 30 to win.
Leigh Kasperek walks into the middle next.

OUT! Green departs! Green comes down the track to this tossed up ball and tries to clear the mid-wicket boundary. Doesn't get enough power behind it and Deepti Sharma comes running in to her left. She dives and takes a superb catch. India inching closer towards victory.
Fuller and slower, just outside off, she moves across the stumps and slogs it over mid-wicket. Gets a single for doing so.
Wide! Too far outside off, across the tramline, wide signalled.
FOUR! Shot. Clean as a whistle. Tossed up and outside off, Martin gets close to the pitch and lofts it cleanly over extra cover for a boundary.
Stays back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Slow, turning in from outside off, Maddy Green comes down the track and slaps it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Short ball into the body, Martin pulls it through mid-wicket and sends it across the boundary line.
Green is safe. She smacks this towards mid off and sets off for the run. There is a direct hit scored at the bowler's end and it's taken upstairs. Replays roll in and it shows she's safe.
Maddy Green comes out to the middle next.

OUT! That's the wicket India wanted. The big wicket of Suzie Bates. She departs in the hunt for the big runs. Low full toss outside off, Bates looks to clear the off side but ends up slicing it to Hemalatha at point. She gobbles it up without any trouble. Is that the final nail in the coffin for New Zealand?
Full outside off, driven square on the off side for nothing.
Good length delivery outside the line of off stump, Martin punches it through covers and rotate strike.
Full toss on the stumps, Bates slogs it aerially through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Arundhati Reddy returns.
The batter has swept that one through the leg side. Single to the total.
Lofts this full ball back over the bowler's head and gets two.
Katey Martin is the new batter in.

OUT! Another wicket down! Tossed up on the stumps, Satterthwaite stands her ground and looks to slog sweep it. It lobs towards Radha Yadav at square leg. She settles herself under the ball well and takes it well. Bates is running out of partners here. New Zealand in some trouble.
Suzie steps out of the crease and slogs it over mid-wicket for one more.
Satterthwaite takes a step out of the crease and lofts it down towards long off for a run.
Bates isn't exactly in control of this. She looks to slog over the leg side but gets a leading edge over covers. One run taken.
Dayalan Hemalatha returns.
Drills it down the ground, through to long on for a single.
Driven wide of the mid off fielder this time. A single is taken.
Full and on off stump, Amy drills it towards mid off.
High full toss around off, Bates heaves it over mid-wicket. A run collected. No no ball given surprisingly.
Across again, she gets low and paddles it fine down the leg side. Two more to the total.
FOUR! Suzie Bates carries on! Moves well across her sticks, gets low and plays a powerful paddle scoop for a boundary to fine leg.
Radha Yadav is back on.
Outside off, it goes off the edge and down towards third man for one. 114 needed in 54 balls.

FOUR! That's hit with a lot of power. Fifty for Suzie Bates, her 20th in this format and she becomes the leading run-scorer in WWT20. Backs away and hammers this turning ball past the diving long on fielder.
Short, going away and outside off, Satterthwaite slaps it through the covers for a single.
Quite slow through the air, on the stump, pushed back to the bowler.
Spinning away from around off, pushed tamely to the cover fielder.
Lofts it over the bowler's head for a run.
Deepti Sharma is back on.
Short ball and it is pulled away on the leg side.
Wide! Too far outside off, across the tramline, wide called.
Too far outside off, Amy can't make any contact.
Amy Satterthwaite to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Two in two for Poonam Yadav. This is turning out to be a superb over. It's tossed up outside off, Watkin goes across to sweep but loses her balance in the process. Misses, is out of her crease and Bhatia behind the stumps is quick to whip the bails off.
Jess Watkin is the new batter in.
OUT! GONE! Sophie Devine is out of here. Short, slow and wide outside off, in an attempt to bash this away, Devine slaps it to captain Kaur at extra cover. She moves to her right and takes it well.
Lovely effort from Reddy. Bates sweeps this fine down the leg side. Reddy chases it down and pulls it back just inside the rope. Saves a vital run for her side.
Full and slow on the stumps, swept away into the leg side.
A dot to end but a good over, 9 from it. On off, it is kept out.
SIX! All the way! They need a few more like this. Short and it is a nothing delivery. Devine goes back and pulls it over the square leg fence. 125 more in 67.
The batter works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Eases it down to long on for a run.

NOT OUT! And that is why! She is well in. Short and outside off, Bates cuts it to cover-point. The two batters think of a run but then opt against it. Devine now turns and tries to make it back. The fielder throws it to the keeper who takes the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that Devine has made it in time.
Big moment in the game! A run out appeal has been taken upstairs. Bates is the woman in question. This would be a big wicket for India. However, she seems relaxed.
Full on the middle pole, the batter hits it to long on for another single.
A dot to end! Outside off, the shot finds the woman at covers.
Poonam continues tossing it up, Bates hits it down to long off for a run.
FOUR! How good was that? Bates moved right across, she was way outside the off stump. Yadav floats it up outside off. The sweep comes out and it is hit through square leg for a boundary.
The googly outside off, it is hit through covers for a run.
Slower through the air again outside off, Bates waits and then hits it through covers for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Bates slaps it to covers.
Poonam Yadav to roll her arm over.
Plays the sweep shot through mid-wicket for a run.
Almost plays it on! Short and closer to the off pole, also stays low. Devine goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge towards short fine leg for a run.
Nicely bowled! Tosses it up outside off, the batter lunges and tries to keep it out but is beaten as she plays inside the line.
Sophie Devine to bat next.

OUT! India draw first blood! A much-needed wicket for them. They have broken the opening stand. This was bowled flatter and outside off, Peterson tries to guide it down to the third man region. The ball takes a faint edge and goes into the mitts of the keeper. She takes a sharp catch. An appeal follows and the umpire raises the finger. Hemalatha is pumped up and why not, this is her maiden T20I wicket.
Short and it sticks in the surface. Bates is early into the pull. It hits the bottom edge and goes towards mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish and outside off, Bates makes room and cuts it but to the fielder at point.
Dayalan Hemalatha introduced into the attack.

FOUR! Innovation and it comes off very well! Moves right across and paddle scoops it through short fine leg for a boundary. 50 up and the score after the first six is 51. New Zealand are on track to chase this down. 144 more needed.
Another slower ball, once again there is hardly any bounce. Bates swats it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Shuffles across and swings but is beaten by the low bounce. The keeper fumbles and a bye is taken.
In the air... but safe! Peterson comes down and mistimes a shot over mid off. Two taken.
Cramps the batter for room by bowling on the body. It is pushed down to long on for a run.
The slower one to begin  with. Bates is down the track but mistimes it to long on for two.
Arundhati Reddy is back.
Short and very slow! Bates is way too early into the pull. She gets a top edge towards short third man. A single taken.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Floats it a little too full than needed. Bates slaps it through covers and a boundary results.
Slower through the air on middle, Peterson comes down the track and swings but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for a run.
Uses her feet but can't get to the pitch of it. It is pushed to mid on.
Very slow on the stumps, Bates makes room but is done in by the pace. She cuts it towards covers for a run.
Makes room and slaps it down to long off for a single.
A single to end a good over for New Zealand. It is eased down to long off for a run.
Fires it outside off, Bates goes for the cut but misses.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over! Bates uses her feet and hits it through wide mid on for another boundary. New Zealand now getting a move on here.
Another hoick but the ball takes the inside edge, goes past the keeper and down to the third man region. Couple taken.
FOUR! Not off the middle but New Zealand won't care. Once again it is on the stumps, Bates swings but gets it off the inner half through mid-wicket and the ball races away.
Shuffles right across and Radha bowls it outside off. The slog sweep comes out but it is mistimed towards mid-wicket.
Pushes through the covers for a single.
FOUR! A touch short, around off, Bates stays leg side to this. Backs away and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Safe. Peterson survives. She taps this towards mid off and takes off. The throw comes in at the bowler's end and Sharma takes the bails off. It goes up and replays show Peterson is fine.
Wide! Down the leg side, the keeper can't collect and so the batters take an extra run. Wide called as well.
That was close. Bates slaps this back towards the bowler. Sharma deflects it onto the stumps behind her but Peterson is well in.
Seeing the batter give the charge, Sharma drags the length back. Cut to cover eventually.
Minimal turn, Peterson pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Deepti Sharma to bowl now.
Moves across the stick and drills it to mid on for a single.
Quick outside off, tapped in front of covers for a quick single.
On the shorter side of things outside off, punched away on the off side.
Slower one outside off, Bates has to wait a lot of time as she chops it just past the keeper behind. One run to the total.
Length ball outside off, cut square to point.
Short, flat and outside off from around the wicket, Bates goes back and slaps the pull towards mid on.
Radha Yadav to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! A boundary to start the over and a boundary to end it! Full and on the pads, it is worked fine down the leg side. Beats the dive of the fielder there and a boundary results. 11 from the first, ideal start for New Zealand.
Back of a length around off, Peterson guides it to point.
The batter dances down the track. The batters have run through for a single.
Now a couple! Short and wide outside off, Bates slashes, she gets an outside edge through backward point for a couple.
Better! Does not offer room and lands it on middle, it is pushed to mid on.

FOUR! Runs straightaway and that too a boundary! India started off with one and New Zealand too start off with one. On the shorter side outside off, Bates guides it through point and a boundary results.
We are back for the chase! Suzie Bates and Anna Peterson are the openers. The former will be on strike and she will face Arundhati Reddy. Here we go...
